title: Web development foundations
description: Start with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, then explore responsive design, performance and privacy. Follow a course from start to finish or jump to the topic you need for your next project.
requirements: A browser and a code editor

title: Build your first Android app
description: Learn Kotlin and build Android interfaces with Jetpack Compose. The course starts with programming basics and progresses through app architecture, data and adaptive layouts.
requirements: A computer that meets Android Studio requirements

title: Build a web app with Cloud Firestore
description: Create a restaurant recommendation app while learning Firestore queries, real-time updates, Firebase Authentication and security rules. Check the current service limits before enabling any paid features.

title: Explore Gemini for your next project
description: Work through Google's introductory Gemini learning pathway and explore how to add generative AI to an application. Review API pricing, usage limits and data handling before using a real API key.
requirements: A Google account may be needed for hands-on API exercises

title: Flutter learning resources
description: Find official tutorials, codelabs and examples for building Flutter applications. Pick a project that matches your experience and use the documentation alongside it.

title: Learn GitHub by doing
description: Practice GitHub workflows through guided learning activities. Build confidence with repositories, collaboration and the tools you will use on a team project.
requirements: A GitHub account for interactive exercises

title: Make your projects accessible
description: Learn how people use assistive technology and how to build interfaces that work for more people. Cover semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus and accessible forms.

title: Build an installable web app
description: Explore progressive web app fundamentals, installation, service workers and offline behavior. Use these guides to plan which capabilities your project can support on each browser.
